scope: Planning package; all engineering implementation tasks are future work.

packets.title: Baseline preservation and reproducible defect inventory
edge_cases: A merged repair may already address part of a source allegation
Missing historical mesh bytes cannot be reconstructed as original evidence
Dirty coordination journals belong to their existing owner

tasks.title: Claim scope and freeze the execution starting point
tasks.instructions: Before any edits, reread root coordination and append a scoped claim with exact paths, dependencies and current resource limits. Record main SHA, integration SHA, toolchain identities and selected tracked-file hashes in execution/BASELINE.json. Confirm the planned base cc86edc still matches; classify later changes before proceeding.
tasks.acceptance: Immutable baseline inventory and explicit drift disposition exist.
tasks.negative_control: A mismatched source SHA must block reuse of its defect finding.

tasks.title: Preserve historical semantics
tasks.instructions: Inventory v1 requirements, preregistration, wave receipts, meshes still available, and known pruned inputs. Tag the old lane only after the owner accepts its exact head; never overwrite historical observations.
tasks.acceptance: Each historical record is retained or explicitly unavailable.
tasks.negative_control: A scalar receipt without its governing mesh cannot qualify the missing case.

tasks.title: Reproduce the defect register
tasks.instructions: For D-01 through D-31, bind file, symbol, current line, source SHA, observed behavior and minimal reproducer. Separate code-confirmed defects from untested physical hypotheses.
tasks.acceptance: Every defect maps to one primary repair task and an independent failing fixture.
tasks.negative_control: A changed line number alone cannot prove a defect remains present.

tasks.title: Carry forward deferred v4 work
tasks.instructions: Import TR-16 and EV-09/EV-12 section-6 dispositions into the new evidence, acquisition and admission packets. Preserve scoped closure rather than relabeling it complete science.
tasks.acceptance: No previous deferred dependency disappears from the new register.
tasks.negative_control: An earlier DONE-SCOPED receipt must not become qualified physical PASS.

tasks.title: Publish baseline handoff and ownership map
tasks.instructions: Complete the initial claim with baseline/defect inventory, preserved dirty paths, proposed exact ownership boundaries and no assumed allocation. Reread remote COORD.md before handing off. Reserve root manifests/status/contracts for the integrator.
tasks.acceptance: Claim precedes edits and records existing dirty paths.
tasks.negative_control: A proposed ownership allocation without acknowledgement is not a concurrency grant.

packets.title: Repair current misleading observations and presentation
edge_cases: Legacy receipt schemas stay readable
Missing physical observations remain Unknown
No root status boolean may be manually promoted
validation_commands: rtk proxy python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_v5_truth.py

tasks.title: Make mandatory gate configuration fail closed
tasks.instructions: In run_elite_3grid_gci_and_rsm.py read mandatory_elite_cfd_gates, reject missing/unknown keys and delete the result-shaped 25% improvement condition. Emit a new interpretation report for existing dossiers.
tasks.acceptance: Missing preregistration cannot fall through to passing defaults; comparisons use same-pipeline control.
tasks.negative_control: Misspell the key and supply the old mismatched CT-35 baseline; both must fail admission.

tasks.title: Withdraw assigned geometry measurements
tasks.instructions: In f0_enactment.py and VoxelSdfObserver classify copied deltas, hard-coded powder counts and star-wall topology as not measured. Keep proxy values separately labeled for legacy reproduction.
tasks.acceptance: Proxy values cannot satisfy a geometry gate.
tasks.negative_control: An enclosed cavity in an artifact ignored by the legacy observer cannot return a measured zero.

tasks.title: Correct checkpoint and transport claim names
tasks.instructions: Rename compatibility-only checkpoint_determinism_verified at new schema boundaries; relabel verify_dispersion_and_les_partition as arithmetic-only. Require explicit unsupported real resume and well-mixed capabilities until native tests exist.
tasks.acceptance: Neither helper authorizes restart or turbulent-transport qualification.
tasks.negative_control: Empty islands and literal hashes cannot yield a verified campaign replay record.

tasks.title: Remove stale UI and implicit GPU claims
tasks.instructions: Replace retracted pressure-reduction strings in main.tsx with evidence-bound historical labels; mark authored trajectories SCHEMATIC. Remove implicit attach_cuda_audit_with_vram activation and fabricated tensor/parcel productivity claims.
tasks.acceptance: The explorer matches current evidence and ordinary runs request no GPU implicitly.
tasks.negative_control: A missing measured trajectory or GPU lease cannot be rendered or executed as if supplied.

tasks.title: Protect run outputs and physical screen identity
tasks.instructions: Make CLI output defaults unique ignored run paths and refuse existing public receipt paths. Version analytic mass/fixed-load structural observations as estimates; make no buckling assertion. Correct duplicated baseline dimensions only through a new identity.
tasks.acceptance: Fresh runs preserve committed receipts byte-for-byte.
tasks.negative_control: Existing output, unknown subject equivalence and a changed downstream tail are rejected.

packets.title: Requirements authority and decision profiles
edge_cases: No source proposal silently admits a load or pressure limit
A new fork does not reset experiment-family alpha
A qualified template must remain non-runnable when limits are unresolved

tasks.title: Represent limit status explicitly
tasks.instructions: Add RequirementValue<T> with Admitted, Proposed and Unresolved states, source identity and applicability. Draft v2 without changing historical v1. Remove sandbox_pdr_min from qualified policy.
tasks.acceptance: Qualified admission names every unresolved mandatory limit.
tasks.negative_control: A proposed 2.5 MPa load, 3 mm passage or borrowed PDR window cannot be treated as admitted.

tasks.title: Resolve duty and interface conflicts
tasks.instructions: Build a machine-readable conflict register for split tolerance, DSD medians, concentration basis, 45 mm envelope, machined overflow and printed passages. Copy D1-D4 values from the exact preregistration, with deviations retained.
tasks.acceptance: Every new scenario has units, weighting basis and source.
tasks.negative_control: Changing number median to volume median, or borrowing 1.4 mm as a printed passage limit, fails.

tasks.title: Implement semantic DecisionProfile validation
tasks.instructions: Require estimands, complete gate/scenario family, joint sampling model, numerical/model bounds, sidedness, alpha policy, selection/stopping/holdout policy and experiment_family_id. Validate references, not only nonempty strings.
tasks.acceptance: Incomplete families, nonfinite values and inconsistent units are refused before dispatch.
tasks.negative_control: An empty uncertainty array or a missing cold-duty scenario must block admission.

tasks.title: Separate planning precision from statistical inference
tasks.instructions: Encode one-third-of-useful-effect as a run-design budget; encode improvement through the declared confidence procedure. Distinguish simultaneous intervals, fixed-candidate conjunctions and multiple/adaptive winner claims.
tasks.acceptance: The policy states its estimand and controlled error criterion.
tasks.negative_control: Four marginal 95% bounds cannot be labeled simultaneous 95% coverage without justification.

tasks.title: Record external dependency owners
tasks.instructions: List installation loads, supports, system absolute pressure, material/process data, validation access, comparator, lab and license choices with accountable roles and affected claims. Permit benign synthetic work meanwhile.
tasks.acceptance: Each missing input blocks exactly its dependent claims.
tasks.negative_control: A timeout waiting for data must not be converted to infeasibility or zero uncertainty.

packets.title: Typed contracts and enforced blind evaluator boundary
edge_cases: Integrator alone registers workspace members and generated clients
Render-only feature tags must not reach judges
Storage hashes and semantic identity differ

tasks.title: Create units and strict schema foundations
tasks.instructions: Introduce SI newtypes, coordinate frames, unit-checked expression AST and typed error enums. Use joil-evidence as the single canonical identity implementation; register new workspace members in a serialized integrator commit.
tasks.acceptance: Pa/mm/m and density/concentration conversions have independent dimensional fixtures.
tasks.negative_control: Unknown keys, duplicate keys, negative zero ambiguity and nonfinite quantities cannot bypass strict decode.

tasks.title: Define the restricted subject bundle
tasks.instructions: SubjectBundle carries accepted artifacts, unit/frame transforms, material/roughness and contract port/frozen-region tags. Put module kind, ancestry and display labels in a render-only sidecar.
tasks.acceptance: An evaluator can calculate from physical artifacts without importing a genotype.
tasks.negative_control: A bundle containing an expected mechanism score or family bonus fails schema validation.

tasks.title: Separate outcomes at type boundaries
tasks.instructions: Keep TaskOutcome, ObservationState, GateDecision and ClaimEligibility distinct. NumericalFailure/Unsupported/OutOfScope cannot be coerced to physical Fail or Pass. NotApplicable needs a predeclared rule.
tasks.acceptance: Exhaustive state-transition tests cover every nonpassing reason.
tasks.negative_control: A successful process with absent output remains Unknown/Invalid.

tasks.title: Define dependency-complete evaluation keys
tasks.instructions: Bind subject artifacts and tolerances, manufacturing state, scenario, solver/build/container, numerics, randomness, extractor and calibration. Policy decisions have separate keys so weights can rerank without falsifying old observations.
tasks.acceptance: Changing each dependency invalidates only the correct descendant cache.
tasks.negative_control: Identical IR with a different mesh policy or correlated sampling design cannot share an incompatible evaluation.

tasks.title: Enforce architecture and interchange contracts
tasks.instructions: Traverse normal/build/dev Cargo dependencies, include a deliberately indirect forbidden path, and freeze valid/invalid JSON examples plus generated TS types. Architecture test is owned by a dedicated workspace test package.
tasks.acceptance: Any judge-side transitive path to genome/module registries fails CI.
tasks.negative_control: A build-dependency bridge and a label leaking through serialization are both caught.

packets.title: Independent statistics and qualification inference
edge_cases: Weighted parcels are not IID Bernoulli draws
Sobol points are not IID order-statistic samples
Observed-effect power and repeated holdout peeking are forbidden

tasks.title: Replace t approximations and post-hoc power
tasks.instructions: Use a pinned verified distribution routine and retain t(0.975,4)=2.7764451052 as an independent fixture. Plan replication from pilot variance and a fixed useful effect.
tasks.acceptance: Small-n intervals match independent critical values.
tasks.negative_control: The old 2.7275 approximation fails the regression tolerance.

tasks.title: Implement weighted clustered capture uncertainty
tasks.instructions: Estimate capture by represented mass; keep injection strata, carrier realization, time blocks and daughter ancestry. Support replicated randomized quadrature or a justified cluster estimator.
tasks.acceptance: Known unequal-weight and correlated-cohort experiments achieve declared coverage.
tasks.negative_control: Naive Wilson intervals over correlated daughter counts must be rejected.

tasks.title: Implement joint decision bounds
tasks.instructions: Evaluate correlated paired margins and bounded systematic errors under DecisionProfile. Add the four-margin synthetic fixture with n=20 and t(0.9875,19)=2.4334402114.
tasks.acceptance: Lower bounds reproduce approximately 2.912, 1.640, 573.520 and 0.06117 in their stated units.
tasks.negative_control: One failed margin, invalid bias bound or nonpositive baseline blocks the claimed family.

tasks.title: Verify multiplicity, tails and censoring
tasks.instructions: Port Holm/Cliff/order-statistic routines with independent fixtures. Enforce IID assumptions behind n>=72/368 tail policies; preserve below-LOQ values as censored observations.
tasks.acceptance: Finite scenario envelopes remain finite envelopes; each displayed interval states interpretation.
tasks.negative_control: Dependent QMC draws and censored zeros cannot manufacture p95 reliability.

tasks.title: Exercise calibration through repeated synthetic trials
tasks.instructions: Preregister null/alternative generators, clustered nonnormal cases and binomial Monte Carlo uncertainty for coverage. Charge every adaptive confirmation attempt in the experiment-family ledger.
tasks.acceptance: Coverage and false-qualification tests are distinguished and reported with uncertainty.
tasks.negative_control: Forking a failed family or selecting a new winner cannot erase earlier alpha spending.

packets.title: Private content store, exact caches and revocation
edge_cases: A fingerprint detects near-duplicates but cannot authorize reuse
Symlink/path escapes and cross-filesystem rename require explicit handling
Revoked evidence remains historically inspectable

tasks.title: Implement immutable artifact publication
tasks.instructions: Write hashed bytes into a fresh same-filesystem staging directory, fsync files/manifest, verify hashes, rename atomically and fsync the parent. Reject traversal and symlink escape.
tasks.acceptance: No published object points to partial bytes.
tasks.negative_control: Crash after each write, truncated bytes and a mismatched digest never produce an accepted object.

tasks.title: Model artifact closure and exact cache lookup
tasks.instructions: Store parent dependencies, semantic and storage digests, content type, array units/layout and disclosure class. Cache only complete compatible closures; record near-duplicate fingerprints separately.
tasks.acceptance: Cache reuse verifies all required objects and identities.
tasks.negative_control: Same shape fingerprint with changed boundary/solver/extractor cannot reuse a result.

tasks.title: Define object-store and backup semantics
tasks.instructions: Use immutable uploads plus a conditional manifest pointer for object storage. Keep SQLite local. Implement backup restore from verified roots before considering remote workers.
tasks.acceptance: A lost coordinator can recover a complete verified checkpoint closure.
tasks.negative_control: A stale latest pointer or missing object must not select an incomplete checkpoint.

tasks.title: Propagate revocation and stale status
tasks.instructions: Add append-only invalidation events; traverse dependent decisions, qualified archives, scenes and paper claims. Keep original observations and reason, then schedule permitted reevaluation.
tasks.acceptance: A withdrawn calibration visibly revokes every affected claim.
tasks.negative_control: An already rendered image cannot retain a current PASS badge after its source is revoked.

tasks.title: Implement retention and disclosure classification
tasks.instructions: Mark roots from accepted claims/checkpoints; retain governing meshes/fields and raw reductions. Propagate private geometry classification to images. Define reviewed export allowlists.
tasks.acceptance: GC cannot remove claim-bearing evidence; public exports use explicit reviewed selections.
tasks.negative_control: Keeping only a scalar summary is insufficient grounds to delete its governing mesh.

packets.title: Durable task execution, leases and complete accounting
edge_cases: At-least-once attempts may incur duplicate real cost
Expired historic leases grant no current GPU allocation
Actual elapsed cost is not a deterministic logical ledger

tasks.title: Create the local transactional task store
tasks.instructions: Define SQLite tables for tasks, attempts, leases, events, object references, reservations, charges and family decisions; migrate with strict version checks and backup.
tasks.acceptance: Ready/Leased/Running/Staged/Verified/Committed transitions are explicit and atomic.
tasks.negative_control: A process exit without verified artifact closure cannot commit.

tasks.title: Fence stale and duplicate workers
tasks.instructions: Use unique attempt IDs and increasing fencing tokens. Commit checks the live fence and exact evaluation key inside the same transaction. Persist consistency conflicts.
tasks.acceptance: Duplicate delivery commits once; a stale lease cannot overwrite a newer attempt.
tasks.negative_control: An old worker finishing after a retry is quarantined and its actual cost is still charged.

tasks.title: Reserve and reconcile resource budgets
tasks.instructions: Reserve CPU/GPU time, RAM/VRAM and scratch before dispatch; reconcile actual use and release unused reservations. State bounded in-flight overshoot, cold/warm cache and shared-study allocation policies.
tasks.acceptance: No admitted task overcommits the remaining authorized resource vector.
tasks.negative_control: A failed retry, cache lookup, audit or surrogate fit cannot disappear from accounting.

tasks.title: Enforce physical topology and process boundaries
tasks.instructions: Read hwloc/sysfs/cpuset topology rather than logical-CPU modulo. Enforce child-process limits and cancellation only inside the task-owned process group/cgroup.
tasks.acceptance: MPI ranks times threads and nested libraries remain within the lease.
tasks.negative_control: An overlapping sibling-core allocation or expired lease prevents dispatch; no other project is signaled.

tasks.title: Add the deterministic synthetic executor
tasks.instructions: Run nonempty proposals and artifact-producing fixture tasks with injected timeouts, unsupported capabilities and numerical failures. Separate these from feasible negative designs.
tasks.acceptance: Actual attempt records reconcile with reservations and accepted observations.
tasks.negative_control: Timeout and unsupported model never become training labels for physical infeasibility.

packets.title: Checkpoint, resume, fork and one-command fixture run
edge_cases: Logical replay and native solver rerun are separate claims
Resume preserves consumed budgets
Newest checkpoint is chosen by verified closure rather than mtime
validation_commands: rtk cargo run --locked -p crucible-cli -- run campaigns/fixture-v5.toml

tasks.title: Specify complete checkpoint closure
tasks.instructions: Persist campaign/dependency hashes, populations, all archives, innovation/species/operator state, RNG addressing, in-flight tasks, pending results, budgets, acquisition splits, event position and stop state.
tasks.acceptance: A schema completeness test restores nonempty state, not placeholders.
tasks.negative_control: Omitting a covariance matrix, pending result or family-attempt ledger is detected.

tasks.title: Publish and restore crash-consistent checkpoints
tasks.instructions: Use the store publication protocol and transactional checkpoint pointer. Keep at least two verified roots; quarantine partial staging and reconcile leases before rescheduling.
tasks.acceptance: Kills before/after rename and DB commit recover a verified state.
tasks.negative_control: Corrupt latest manifest must fall back to the last valid complete root and report the corruption.

tasks.title: Separate resume, fork and seed import
tasks.instructions: Resume requires compatible immutable experiment identity and retains spend. Fork creates a new decision lineage; seed import recompiles genomes and carries no PASS verdict by convenience.
tasks.acceptance: Changed weights reuse compatible observations but recompute decisions.
tasks.negative_control: Changed solver, material, interface or requirement prevents incompatible same-experiment resume.

tasks.title: Define deterministic epoch/result application
tasks.instructions: Address RNG by campaign/island/epoch/proposal/operator/draw and apply results in frozen due-epoch/ordinal order. Record throughput-mode arrival order separately.
tasks.acceptance: Shuffled completion and permitted worker counts reproduce logical search-state digest.
tasks.negative_control: Different real retry time is never forced into an identical actual-cost digest.

tasks.title: Ship explicit CLI lifecycle and stop codes
tasks.instructions: Implement admit/run/status/stop/checkpoint verify/fork with unique private run roots and no auto-install or fleet commandeering. Add bounded SIGINT grace and synthetic kill-9 recovery.
tasks.acceptance: Fresh clone fixture creates a real checkpoint, resumes and verifies offline.
tasks.negative_control: Invalid campaign returns usage/admission status before any resource is spent.

packets.title: One material partition and bounded geometry kernel
edge_cases: Approximate re-distancing is not exact geometry
Independent fluid/solid opening can create gaps or overlap
Incomplete interval cells remain unresolved

tasks.title: Prototype kernel suitability before adoption
tasks.instructions: Wrap an ImplicitEval trait around a plain reference interpreter and a separately pinned candidate kernel. Compare baseline, branch/rejoin, internal lattice and thin-shell cases, including compile time and error bounds.
tasks.acceptance: An ADR admits a backend only for its demonstrated coverage.
tasks.negative_control: JIT/interpreter disagreement blocks it; experimental status cannot be hidden by a pin.

tasks.title: Define a disjoint fluid/solid/void partition
tasks.instructions: Compose one region ownership model including frozen fluid, frozen solids, ports, walls and keepouts. Resolve tie semantics and semantic contract tags independently of module labels.
tasks.acceptance: Every test point has one admissible material owner and matching derived consumers.
tasks.negative_control: Separately filtered fluid and solid that overlap or leave a gap must fail.

tasks.title: Bound geometry approximations
tasks.instructions: Track interval bounds, Lipschitz assumptions, re-distance error and ambiguous cells. Refine around ports and minimum features until error fits policy; otherwise return Unsupported/Unknown.
tasks.acceptance: All distance and volume statements carry computed bounds.
tasks.negative_control: Jump flooding plus a grid pitch cannot be labeled an exact-distance proof.

tasks.title: Preserve exact baseline interfaces
tasks.instructions: Lower CT-35 using original dimensions and immutable terminal faces/collar/taper/tail contract. Distinguish genotype round-trip identity from approximate SDF/B-rep agreement.
tasks.acceptance: Port area/normal/frozen-region errors satisfy the admitted baseline tolerance.
tasks.negative_control: The wrong 20 mm tail diameter, 1070/400 mm lengths or shifted collar is rejected.

tasks.title: Record conformance instead of silent repair
tasks.instructions: Apply bounded filters through the shared partition, record displacement/volume change and a new subject identity. Reject large or connectivity-breaking repair; never truncate a failed program into baseline.
tasks.acceptance: Every repaired geometry is traceable to its exact policy and original proposal.
tasks.negative_control: A vanished blade, disconnected passage or excessive repair cannot be silently accepted.

packets.title: Independent artifact-only geometry and topology observation
edge_cases: Volume Betti numbers differ from boundary-surface Betti numbers
Topology can change below sampling resolution
Semantic paths are not coordinates hard-coded for two jets

tasks.title: Read accepted artifact bytes independently
tasks.instructions: Build observers from mesh/volume artifacts and manifest bounds without access to genotype or expected deltas. Reject mismatched subject or artifact digests before measurement.
tasks.acceptance: Changing the artifact alone changes observations or fails binding.
tasks.negative_control: An observer that ignores its mesh argument fails a mutation-of-input test.

tasks.title: Measure volume connectivity and topology
tasks.instructions: Compute port-seeded fluid reachability and solid attachment; compare two volume-complex methods. Keep boundary topology separately and test ball, torus, hollow ball and disconnected bodies.
tasks.acceptance: Volume ball=(1,0,0), solid torus=(1,1,0); boundary fixtures use their own conventions.
tasks.negative_control: Boundary sphere=(1,0,1) cannot be compared directly with a solid-ball Betti tuple.

tasks.title: Measure enclosed and finite-clearance voids
tasks.instructions: Detect isolated fluid/solid voids and powder paths after clearance erosion under the manufacturing profile. Store path bottlenecks and unresolved cells.
tasks.acceptance: A connected but inaccessible powder pocket fails the clearance gate.
tasks.negative_control: A subvoxel throat cannot be assumed open, and literal zero powder is rejected.

tasks.title: Observe thickness, passages and interface fidelity
tasks.instructions: Measure minimum wall/ligament/passage with uncertainty using distance and independent rays; integrate volume/area/moments and frozen-region differences.
tasks.acceptance: Analytic tubes and asymmetric fixtures have bounded measured errors.
tasks.negative_control: Rotation, non-star cavity and narrow breakthrough must defeat old radial proxies.

tasks.title: Verify enactment and neutral behavior
tasks.instructions: Perturb each active parameter at a scale above representation error; compare physical observables, not expected gene coefficients. Classify Neutral, Unsupported and failed development distinctly.
tasks.acceptance: An active TPMS credited in mass is visibly resolved in the same solid.
tasks.negative_control: A no-op radial_inner_fraction cannot change score or evade subject deduplication.

packets.title: Derived surfaces, volume meshes and honest exports
edge_cases: Projected high-order nodes can invert otherwise valid tetrahedra
A point error bound does not certify topology
Exact STEP is limited to supported kernel subsets

tasks.title: Extract tagged watertight surfaces
tasks.instructions: Derive surfaces from the accepted partition and preserve port/material/roughness tags. Check edge incidence, orientation, self-intersection, slivers, and deviation/volume bounds.
tasks.acceptance: All patches close and reproduce the same accepted physical subject.
tasks.negative_control: Coordinate-plane patch guessing fails rotated and asymmetric port fixtures.

tasks.title: Generate qualified structural meshes
tasks.instructions: Prototype robust P1/P2 tetrahedral routes and record quality/Jacobian bounds after boundary projection. Do not inherit theoretical quality guarantees for a modified algorithm.
tasks.acceptance: Patch, thin-shell and distorted-boundary fixtures retain positive element Jacobians.
tasks.negative_control: A P2 midpoint projection that inverts an element is rejected.

tasks.title: Define solver mesh coverage cards
tasks.instructions: Declare each backend feature support and input tolerance. Unsupported active geometry blocks the served fidelity; frozen-liner mesh reuse requires compatible interface and conservative mapping.
tasks.acceptance: Every artifact names its compiler/kernel/tolerance and admissible consumers.
tasks.negative_control: A resolved lattice cannot silently become a homogenized porous region.

tasks.title: Export consistent engineering and display files
tasks.instructions: Write per-patch SI STL, glTF in metres, 3MF with declared build units and optional STEP labeled Exact or TessellatedApproximation. Hash transforms and approximation bounds.
tasks.acceptance: Unit-cube and CT-35 exports have independently checked dimensions and identity.
tasks.negative_control: A millimetre/metre swap or unsewn shell called exact STEP fails.

tasks.title: Benchmark and retain accepted artifacts
tasks.instructions: Measure compile/mesh cost and yield on the fixed corpus; retain governing mesh and provenance with all claim-bearing raw inputs.
tasks.acceptance: A failed mesh remains a numerical artifact failure, with diagnosis and cost.
tasks.negative_control: A scalar-only receipt cannot authorize deleting the accepted CFD/FEA mesh.

packets.title: MPG schema, bounded development and legacy lowering
edge_cases: Construction dependency DAG does not forbid fluid recirculation loops
Strategy metadata is not a physical gene
Disabled modules and homology have distinct identity needs

tasks.title: Define typed graph and field programs
tasks.instructions: Implement immutable interface references, innovation IDs, typed ports, module topology, bounded field DAG and process choices. Keep strategy state outside physical genotype.
tasks.acceptance: Strict canonical schema round-trips and rejects forward/cyclic construction references.
tasks.negative_control: A fluid branch-and-rejoin is allowed while a cyclic evaluation DAG is rejected.

tasks.title: Implement gas-metered deterministic development
tasks.instructions: Count modules, edges, field nodes, coefficients, rewrite applications and depth in stable order; all limits are campaign data. Emit trace and typed budget failures.
tasks.acceptance: Same genome/contract/compiler yields the same trace and partition identity.
tasks.negative_control: Budget exhaustion cannot truncate into a valid baseline or silently resample.

tasks.title: Lower baseline and legacy recipes explicitly
tasks.instructions: Translate CT-35 and v1-v4 layers into named macros with migration records. Preserve historical interpretation; represent unsupported exotic geometry as Unsupported instead of a radial proxy.
tasks.acceptance: Zero mutation preserves contract identity and certified baseline error bounds.
tasks.negative_control: Old genotype fields cannot disappear while their scores remain active.

tasks.title: Stage field vocabulary by verified coverage
tasks.instructions: Enable chambers, sweeps, junctions, inserts, vanes, shell/ribs and resolved lattices in measured order. Delay neural fields until spectral/Jacobian/resolution proofs exist.
tasks.acceptance: Each enabled primitive has analytic/negative fixtures and downstream capability coverage.
tasks.negative_control: A high-frequency field or folding warp fails before meshing.

tasks.title: Separate mechanism labels from physical truth
tasks.instructions: Emit origin trace for development/debugging and a separate render sidecar. Judges receive only subject and contract tags; equivalent IRs share an evaluation.
tasks.acceptance: Changing labels or strategy state does not alter engineering observations.
tasks.negative_control: An active module name alone cannot affect shear, mass, topology or archive quality.

packets.title: Variation, expressiveness and operator-yield audit
edge_cases: Inapplicable sampled operations are charged once
Dormant/neutral features cannot earn physics credit
A fixture proving expressiveness is not automatically a headline seed
validation_commands: rtk cargo run --locked -p crucible-cli -- verify --suite operator-smoke

tasks.title: Implement initial local and structural operators
tasks.instructions: Add parameter/thickness perturb, split/merge/reconnect, add/remove/duplicate, symmetry changes and homologous crossover with stable innovation IDs. Every attempt returns a typed outcome and cost.
tasks.acceptance: Operator locality and changed artifact observables are recorded.
tasks.negative_control: No applicable operation means a charged rejection, not hidden retries until success.

tasks.title: Create the expressiveness corpus
tasks.instructions: Include the twelve S09 concepts plus asymmetric guide sheet, cavity/rib alternative, nonaxisymmetric chamber and equal-shell/different-interior pairs. Freeze fixtures separately from campaign seeds.
tasks.acceptance: Every concept compiles through supported backends without new source edits.
tasks.negative_control: Two different internal topologies under one shell must not collapse to one subject.

tasks.title: Verify invariants through operator sequences
tasks.instructions: Run bounded property sequences over ports, fixed regions, material partition, graph references and process choices. Check failed and repaired outcomes remain fully charged.
tasks.acceptance: Zero silent baseline substitution across the smoke corpus.
tasks.negative_control: An operator that crosses keepouts or exceeds conformance limits is a typed failure.

tasks.title: Measure mutation yield and physical neutrality
tasks.instructions: Preregister the broad 100000-trial audit after smoke tests and a measured resource lease. Report accepted, failed, duplicate, neutral and budget-exceeded counts by operator/complexity.
tasks.acceptance: Yield totals reconcile to attempted proposals and artifacts.
tasks.negative_control: Dropping failed or neutral proposals from the denominator fails the audit.

tasks.title: Keep adaptive novelty optional
tasks.instructions: Record species/protection policy and enable simple fixed protection first. Motif mining, neural mutation and learned novelty require separately versioned policies and held-out usefulness tests.
tasks.acceptance: Reference policy remains reproducible without adaptive components.
tasks.negative_control: A newly mined motif cannot become an uncharged advantage in one comparison arm.

packets.title: Material/process passports and actual mass
edge_cases: Machined overflow exception does not qualify other printed channels
Ra and equivalent sand roughness are different observables
Material name does not imply environmental qualification

tasks.title: Define process-qualified material records
tasks.instructions: Bind alloy/product form, LPBF parameters, orientation, heat treatment/HIP, finish, temperature/environment and defect assumptions to source evidence and status.
tasks.acceptance: Unresolved allowables are explicit and block affected claims.
tasks.negative_control: Wrought Ti64 data or an alloy-name match cannot qualify an as-built fatigue/sour-service claim.

tasks.title: Integrate mass from the accepted solid
tasks.instructions: Compute density times actual solid volume with geometric/material bounds; cross-check accepted volume mesh. Separate nominal printed, supports/allowances, machined and weighed mass.
tasks.acceptance: Resolved internal solids and ribs contribute to the same CFD/FEA/print subject.
tasks.negative_control: TPMS wall corrugation cannot receive a missing annulus mass credit.

tasks.title: Implement geometric manufacturing gates
tasks.instructions: Measure build fit, internal downskin/spans, support accessibility, powder escape and tool swept-volume access. Apply passport thresholds rather than copied source constants.
tasks.acceptance: A machined orifice has an explicit process/access plan.
tasks.negative_control: A connected cavity without finite-clearance escape or reamer access fails.

tasks.title: Connect finish/orientation to physical evaluation
tasks.instructions: Create calibrated per-face roughness classes and variant identities. Changing orientation/finish invalidates dependent mass/process/structural and hydraulic evaluations where applicable.
tasks.acceptance: The same variant is used for flow, structure and export.
tasks.negative_control: A universal ks=3.1Ra shortcut cannot become admitted without calibration.

tasks.title: Plan coupons and as-built metrology
tasks.instructions: Prepare required tensile/fatigue/density/porosity/roughness/CT calibration records and accountable external dependencies, without placing orders or contacting vendors.
tasks.acceptance: Testable passport acceptance and uncertainty budgets exist.
tasks.negative_control: CT voxel pitch alone cannot satisfy dimensional accuracy or wall-detectability requirements.

packets.title: Corrected native carrier evaluator and control
edge_cases: Fixed feed, split and both outlet pressures overconstrain the case
Negative gauge pressure alone proves no physical impossibility
Residuals/cell count/fixed iterations are not convergence certificates
validation_commands: rtk cargo run --locked -p crucible-cli -- verify --suite native-carrier

tasks.title: Pin and disclose actual native capabilities
tasks.instructions: Reuse the tested Foundation14 environment as starting identity; verify source/build/container/compiler/MPI and model availability. Add Rust case execution/extraction behind a capability card.
tasks.acceptance: The card names exactly what ran, what is absent and native-restart support.
tasks.negative_control: An executable found on PATH without matching build/model identity is refused.

tasks.title: Implement dimensional pressure and energy extraction
tasks.instructions: Read dimensions and reconstruct p/rho, static/total/p_rgh/gauge/absolute pressure with declared gravity/datum. Keep tap drops separate from integrated mechanical flux.
tasks.acceptance: Independent hydrostatic/control-volume fixtures include both outlets and elevation.
tasks.negative_control: A 1000-fold unit error, wrong density or missing reference datum fails.

tasks.title: Control split without imposed result selection
tasks.instructions: Set total inlet flux/profile and treated-outlet pressure; use a bounded reject-backpressure controller with reachability limits and anti-windup. Settle before final statistics unless studying a declared closed loop.
tasks.acceptance: Controller history and frozen sampling settings are retained; PDR is an outcome.
tasks.negative_control: Unreachable split and oscillating/saturated controller block accepted statistics.

tasks.title: Qualify numerics and the full geometry
tasks.instructions: Challenge second-order convection, RSM initialization, prism layers/wall treatment, domain extensions, timestep/correctors, stress realizability and sampling stationarity on the same subject.
tasks.acceptance: Mesh/time/model errors meet preallocated observable-specific budgets.
tasks.negative_control: An oscillatory sequence cannot receive a Richardson certificate; short RSM continuation is not independent validation.

tasks.title: Verify native execution and restart
tasks.instructions: Run pipe/hydrostatics/conservation/rotation/controller fixtures and actual interrupted-native restart with complete field/statistics state. Preserve diagnostics and use only a renewed explicit resource lease.
tasks.acceptance: Accepted observables survive restart inside declared tolerances.
tasks.negative_control: Half-written fields, unknown absolute pressure and failed mesh health never become PASS.

packets.title: Validation accession and controlled vortex/PDR study
edge_cases: Published pressure ranges from other liners are diagnostic context
A convex hull is not a physical validation proof
Secondary/digitized curves cannot fill missing measurement metadata
validation_commands: rtk cargo run --locked -p crucible-cli -- verify --suite vortex

tasks.title: Accession original benchmark evidence
tasks.instructions: For Bai/Young/Zhou/Hsieh candidates, record source/license/digest, geometry, fluids, BCs, station locations, methods and uncertainty; keep raw papers/data private as required.
tasks.acceptance: Every comparison states matched and unresolved inputs.
tasks.negative_control: An attractive overlay without geometry and uncertainty stays a literature comparison.

tasks.title: Preregister the anomaly study
tasks.instructions: Freeze CT-35, taps, duty and analysis; change convection, wall layers, run duration, initialization, outlet/orifice treatment one factor at a time before inspecting outcomes.
tasks.acceptance: The study tests competing explanations rather than assuming an absent vortex.
tasks.negative_control: Borrowed commercial PDR=1.4-2.6 cannot force a tuned passing case.

tasks.title: Validate observables independently
tasks.instructions: Compare tangential/axial profiles, reverse core, pressure/split and grade only where corresponding measurements exist. Quantify numerical/input/experimental discrepancy separately.
tasks.acceptance: Coverage cards state which observable/mechanism/regime is supported.
tasks.negative_control: Good pressure agreement cannot qualify oil grade or a different geometry family.

tasks.title: Challenge multiple stable states
tasks.instructions: Run qualified initializations and up/down duty ramps; retain converged branches and startup/control selection conditions. Keep calibration and held-out geometries separate.
tasks.acceptance: Operational state assumptions appear in requirements and uncertainty.
tasks.negative_control: Selecting the best initialized branch cannot represent general operation.

tasks.title: Admit or narrow the reference comparison
tasks.instructions: Bind G-VTX-style admission to evaluator build and explicit validation scope; leave inaccessible data and unsupported mechanisms open. Define an owned CT-35 measurement protocol without launching it.
tasks.acceptance: Qualified flow archives remain disabled until the matching evidence exists.
tasks.negative_control: A version change or withdrawn dataset revokes dependent ranking authority.

packets.title: Native light-drop forces, face injection and inventory
edge_cases: Light drops need pressure-gradient and added-mass convention checks
Wall-held and in-domain oil are not rejection
Continuous injection and complete pulse cohorts use different estimators
validation_commands: rtk cargo run --locked -p crucible-cli -- verify --suite native-oil

tasks.title: Verify the actual force adapter
tasks.instructions: Use tracer following, valid-regime terminal rise, acceleration response, prescribed rotation and substep order fixtures through production code. Document gravity/pressure convention and drag regime.
tasks.acceptance: Independent signs/magnitudes and refinement trends agree.
tasks.negative_control: Adding a separate centrifugal force in stationary coordinates fails rotation/tracer controls.

tasks.title: Inject by semantic inlet-face normal flux
tasks.instructions: Stratify represented oil mass by inward liquid flux times face area/time/concentration with declared DSD basis. Handle unequal branches, nonuniform flow and inlet backflow explicitly.
tasks.acceptance: Injected mass and momentum match independently integrated inlet values.
tasks.negative_control: Interior coordinate masks or velocity magnitude cannot replace normal-flux quadrature.

tasks.title: Persist full parcel/cohort identity
tasks.instructions: Record represented mass, initial/current size, injection stratum/time, parent/daughter IDs, random stream and terminal state. Keep visual marker size separate.
tasks.acceptance: Restart reconstructs the same cohort and conservation state.
tasks.negative_control: A daughter cannot count as new injected oil or independent replication.

tasks.title: Close terminal and retained inventory
tasks.instructions: Define first-passage/removal/recrossing and wall interaction rules; reconcile reject/treated/wall/domain/discrepancy per size class and synchronized window.
tasks.acceptance: Unresolved mass enters adverse concentration bounds.
tasks.negative_control: Double-counted outlet recrossings and lost wall mass are detected.

tasks.title: Stop on uncertainty and residence evidence
tasks.instructions: Set duration, independent replicates and parcel budget from concentration/decision precision and residence tails. Archive production fields and source-bound extraction.
tasks.acceptance: A completed process with 97% retained oil reports no qualified grade.
tasks.negative_control: Fixed 32 parcels or 0.01 s cannot satisfy a full-residence requirement by itself.

packets.title: Dispersion, breakup and transport uncertainty
edge_cases: An arithmetic identity is not a well-mixed transport test
One shared velocity can erase size separation
Transfer kernels need demonstrated linear noninteracting validity

tasks.title: Verify native well-mixed dispersion
tasks.instructions: Evolve tracer ensembles in prescribed inhomogeneous anisotropic turbulence; compare independent invariant density/covariance and boundary/refinement behavior. Use an intentionally wrong drift.
tasks.acceptance: Correct production adapter passes and wrong-drift adapter fails.
tasks.negative_control: A telescoping finite-difference identity cannot produce dispersion qualification.

tasks.title: Match dispersion to resolved turbulence
tasks.instructions: Use RSM covariance-consistent anisotropic dispersion and LES unresolved-energy partition; record realizability repairs and inlet sensitivity.
tasks.acceptance: No double counting of resolved and modeled turbulent fluctuations.
tasks.negative_control: Isotropic or full-energy LES noise is caught by covariance/energy controls.

tasks.title: Implement mass-conserving breakup bounds
tasks.instructions: Use exposure-dependent rate/daughter models with explicit data status; retain Hinze diameter as a diagnostic. Compare off/calibrated-on or adverse bounds until model calibration is valid.
tasks.acceptance: Daughter mass closes and model uncertainty cannot be hidden by clipping.
tasks.negative_control: Instantaneous universal Hinze clipping cannot become calibrated breakup.

tasks.title: Qualify population and scenario reuse
tasks.instructions: Refine size classes and velocity groups; verify Smoluchowski/known-kernel cases. Admit a DSD transfer matrix only within linear noninteracting conditions and check a direct held-out rerun.
tasks.acceptance: Reweighted outcomes conserve injected mass and match the direct scenario within budget.
tasks.negative_control: Coalescence/concentration coupling invalidates shortcut reuse.

tasks.title: Bind weighted uncertainty and limitations
tasks.instructions: Carry cluster/ancestry/time-block sampling from crucible-stats; separate class/substep/model errors. Declare films, enrichment, free gas, solids and two-way coupling exclusions.
tasks.acceptance: Every grade observation has units, basis, sampling design and applicability.
tasks.negative_control: More correlated daughter parcels cannot shrink the interval as if IID.

packets.title: Common-flow capacity, energy, mass-reserve decisions
edge_cases: Feasible scenario sets must intersect at the same Q
No epsilon denominator for infeasible baseline
Mean quality is not a universal pointwise quality claim

tasks.title: Preserve exact concentration oracles
tasks.instructions: Retain Cu=Ci(1-E)/(1-r), unclipped reduced efficiency, mass/volume DSD basis and adverse unresolved inventory. Implement synchronized transient outlet concentration separately.
tasks.acceptance: 500 mg/L, E=.94, r=.02 gives 30.6122449 and fails 30; minimum capture .9412.
tasks.negative_control: Missing split denominator, clipped negative reduced efficiency and daughter double count fail.

tasks.title: Build common-flow operating maps
tasks.instructions: Evaluate all required scenarios at common feed points; retain failures/gaps and bracket every transition. Continuous-band claims require admitted interpolation/regularity evidence; otherwise report sampled capacity only.
tasks.acceptance: Disjoint feasible scenario maps produce no false common duty.
tasks.negative_control: Independently maximizing each scenario then taking min, or crossing a failure island, fails.

tasks.title: Version treated-volume mechanical energy
tasks.instructions: Introduce energy_flux_loss_per_treated_m3 from all port fluxes at frozen common duty. Keep old static_pressure_work_per_feed_m3 as historical.
tasks.acceptance: Independent control-volume fixture includes kinetic/gravity and both outlet terms.
tasks.negative_control: Per-feed energy mislabeled per treated volume is rejected.

tasks.title: Define four bounded objectives behind gates
tasks.instructions: Use actual printed mass upper bound, common-demand structural reserve lower bound, compliant treated capacity lower bound and common-duty energy upper bound. Apply 0.35/0.20/0.30/0.15 only as a proposed sensitivity profile until frozen.
tasks.acceptance: Hard constraints and baseline no-regression floors precede preference.
tasks.negative_control: A missing buckling/material gate cannot be compensated by light mass or high utility.

tasks.title: Handle ratios, uncertainty and policy changes
tasks.instructions: Use DecisionProfile for joint gain bounds and multiplicity. Require positive qualified baseline, declared reservation/aspiration scales and immutable utility/reference point.
tasks.acceptance: Changed weights create a new decision over compatible observations.
tasks.negative_control: Undefined baseline capacity or equal aspiration/reservation cannot become a finite winning utility.

packets.title: Candidate-specific structural loads, static FEA and buckling
edge_cases: Common external demand does not mean copied CT-35 traction
Singular point stresses need predeclared finite observables
Eigenbuckling is a screen, not nonlinear collapse validation
validation_commands: rtk cargo run --locked -p crucible-cli -- verify --suite native-structure

tasks.title: Freeze installation load families
tasks.instructions: Define operating flow, external differential/upset, support/preload/contact, handling and thermal cases with admitted sources. Keep draft 2.5 MPa explicitly provisional.
tasks.acceptance: Every family multiplier 1 means the same external demand across designs.
tasks.negative_control: A weaker design cannot choose an easier reference load.

tasks.title: Map each candidate own pressure and shear
tasks.instructions: Transfer accepted CFD tractions onto the same solid mesh; retain interpolation identity and independently integrate applied force/moment and reactions.
tasks.acceptance: Conservative transfer errors fit a preallocated mapping budget.
tasks.negative_control: Copied 29468.22 Pa, wrong normals or missing shear/patches fail.

tasks.title: Qualify native static FEA first
tasks.instructions: Use a pinned mature solver through isolated process adapter. Run patch, rigid body, Lamé, cantilever, reaction/energy balance and mesh-convergence fixtures; preserve analytic screens only as oracles.
tasks.acceptance: Finite declared stress/deflection outputs are tied to material/process and support evidence.
tasks.negative_control: A fixed-load formula cannot produce structural qualification.

tasks.title: Add stability and imperfection challenges
tasks.instructions: Run eigenbuckling then nonlinear collapse for finalists with declared defects/contact. Compare applicable cylinder references, imperfections and mesh sensitivity.
tasks.acceptance: Governing load multiplier is reported with method and validity.
tasks.negative_control: A high yield margin cannot mask untested external-pressure buckling.

tasks.title: Compute reserve without mixing ratios
tasks.instructions: For each admitted load family compute allowable multiplier over its required factor; combine governing compatible limits conservatively. Keep modal/fatigue requirements separate unless multiplier definition is justified.
tasks.acceptance: Reserve refers to common demand and explicit load re-solves where nonlinear.
tasks.negative_control: Frequency ratio or fatigue safety factor cannot be blindly min-combined as the same load multiplier.

packets.title: Wet dynamics, finite-life fatigue and as-built uncertainty
edge_cases: Pressure RMS alone does not specify fatigue cycle spectrum
Wet modes require fluid/support coupling
CT registration and detectability errors enter the as-built subject

tasks.title: Qualify dynamic loads and wet modes
tasks.instructions: Use accepted wall-pressure spectra, fluid added mass and actual supports. Check participation/forced response and relevant broadband excitation rather than one assumed PVC frequency.
tasks.acceptance: Cantilever/fluid-added-mass fixtures and modal mesh checks pass.
tasks.negative_control: A copied 418 Hz field or nominal Strouhal ratio cannot authorize dynamics.

tasks.title: Define finite-life fatigue estimands
tasks.instructions: Use process/orientation/finish/defect-specific curves, mean-stress treatment, cycle-count spectrum and declared run-out target. Record model/data uncertainty.
tasks.acceptance: Every fatigue statement names finite life and supporting passport.
tasks.negative_control: A 1e7-cycle screen cannot be described as infinite life or qualification for arbitrary chemistry.

tasks.title: Bind metrology to a new physical subject
tasks.instructions: Qualify CT calibration, registration, feature detectability and surface/roughness measurement. Build as-built partition and rerun affected physics where shape changes matter.
tasks.acceptance: Nominal and as-built identities, masses and deviations remain separate.
tasks.negative_control: CT voxel pitch or measured Ra cannot silently become dimensional accuracy or ks.

tasks.title: Propagate correlated material/manufacturing bounds
tasks.instructions: Use joint uncertainty or adverse bounded propagation across geometry, loads and material; distinguish deterministic tolerances from probabilistic distributions.
tasks.acceptance: Finite corner results remain bounded scenarios rather than p95 reliability.
tasks.negative_control: Eight selected offsets cannot claim a distribution-free p95.

tasks.title: Apply independent structural confirmation
tasks.instructions: Cross-check governing observables with a qualified second route where required, including mapping, nonlinear stability and load cases. Keep discrepancy as an uncertainty contribution.
tasks.acceptance: Agreement and disagreement have explicit envelope/claim effects.
tasks.negative_control: Two solvers sharing the same wrong boundary/load file cannot qualify the missing physical input.

packets.title: Deterministic reference-search policy and fair controls
edge_cases: Exploration eligibility is not qualified feasibility
Every initialization refill and failed operator is charged
Bounded working sets do not delete historical Pareto evidence
validation_commands: rtk cargo run --locked -p crucible-cli -- run campaigns/fixture-v5.toml

tasks.title: Freeze reference-search/1 as executable policy
tasks.instructions: Start with 4 islands x32, 32 attempted offspring/island/epoch, stable proposal-ID ties, fixed operator shares and bounded initialization/refill. Store all values in policy TOML.
tasks.acceptance: Known constrained fronts and charged proposal counts reproduce exactly.
tasks.negative_control: Inapplicable operation cannot trigger hidden uncharged resampling.

tasks.title: Separate population/archive evidence classes
tasks.instructions: Keep exploration/protected, screen and qualified pools distinct; use measured descriptor bins and bounded nondominated sets. Preserve complete evidence front in durable store.
tasks.acceptance: Unknown/numerical/unsupported outcomes cannot dominate physical candidates.
tasks.negative_control: A gene-derived family label cannot key a qualified QD cell.

tasks.title: Implement fixed operators and migration first
tasks.instructions: Use documented 40/20/10/10/10/10 operator mix and 50/30/20 parent-source shares with explicit empty-source fallbacks. Ring migration every 10 epochs and protection expiration are deterministic.
tasks.acceptance: All selection/adaptation state is checkpointed and charged.
tasks.negative_control: Source fallback cannot insert a favorable baseline after mutation failure.

tasks.title: Run random and conventional controls fairly
tasks.instructions: Share grammar sampler and budgets wherever representation permits; tune fixed-dimensional CMA-ES/BO controls credibly. Separate representation x optimizer factorial contrasts from full-system comparisons.
tasks.acceptance: Cost-quality curves include initialization, failures, inference, audits and confirmation.
tasks.negative_control: Comparing 450 evolved proposals to 1350 hidden surrogate proposals is rejected.

tasks.title: Prove reference search on independent fixtures
tasks.instructions: Use known ZDT/DTLZ/constrained/QD landscapes and exact small-front hypervolume oracles. Drive real physics only after its admission gates; synthetic demos are explicitly labeled.
tasks.acceptance: The optimizer can lose to random without changing thresholds or endpoint.
tasks.negative_control: A smooth gene-formula optimum cannot become an engineering discovery claim.

packets.title: Multi-fidelity acquisition, surrogate calibration and audits
edge_cases: Promoted-only rank correlation is selection-biased
Surrogates allocate work and cannot emit scientific PASS
Lineage neighbors cannot leak between training and holdout

tasks.title: Build the admitted independent-label dataset
tasks.instructions: Use exact subject-bound qualified observations and family/lineage grouped splits; preserve missing/invalid/out-of-scope reasons. Carry EV-09 readiness and EV-12 disposition limits explicitly.
tasks.acceptance: Sandbox descriptors stay in a separate dataset namespace.
tasks.negative_control: A recipe prior or pruned raw input cannot become an independent solver label.

tasks.title: Implement fixed acquisition allocation
tasks.instructions: After a direct-evaluation warmup use 60/20/10/10 improvement/uncertainty/diversity/random when calibrated; otherwise 50% rank/crowding and 50% eligible random. Use deterministic largest-remainder rounding.
tasks.acceptance: No duplicate batch selections and no unaffordable overcommit.
tasks.negative_control: Empty category or odd batch size cannot silently favor one emitter.

tasks.title: Measure random audit ranking fidelity
tasks.instructions: Promote a separately randomized low-ranked-inclusive stream; estimate recall/rank disagreement and false omissions with uncertainty. Audit costs enter every arm ledger.
tasks.acceptance: A failed screen budget suspends its pruning authority.
tasks.negative_control: High correlation among handpicked elites cannot admit a broad screen.

tasks.title: Calibrate and abstain honestly
tasks.instructions: Verify held-out interval coverage/OOD behavior, unsupported geometries and changing data distribution. Store training/observer/model identities and calibration state.
tasks.acceptance: Out-of-scope or miscalibrated predictions defer to direct evaluation.
tasks.negative_control: Predicted metric cannot enter qualified archive, claim or physical gate.

tasks.title: Exercise anti-exploit and policy revisions
tasks.instructions: Add resolution/rotation challenges, planted underresolved gaps and optional disagreement island. Learned embeddings/bandits/motifs are v2 policies with frozen epochs/crosswalks.
tasks.acceptance: A detected exploit quarantines dependent claims and becomes a regression.
tasks.negative_control: Adaptive refitting cannot silently change archive coordinates or reset the registered comparison.

packets.title: Leased workers, measured benchmarks and scaling
edge_cases: Historic host inventory is not current allocation
CPU-seconds and heterogeneous GPU-seconds are not inherently equal
Shared-host contention can invalidate benchmark interpretation

tasks.title: Define worker protocol and capability negotiation
tasks.instructions: Use authenticated transport, registered solver/artifact operations, strict schema versions and bounded process arguments; no arbitrary shell execution from campaign expressions.
tasks.acceptance: Workers accept only task-owned paths/capabilities and current fences.
tasks.negative_control: Untrusted artifact paths, unsupported schema and stale lease requests fail.

tasks.title: Enforce complete resource vectors
tasks.instructions: Discover actual physical topology and current allowance; reserve cores/RAM/scratch/VRAM/walltime/I/O. Default to 4 physical cores,12 GiB,5 GiB,no GPU until superseded explicitly.
tasks.acceptance: Every child and nested numerical library fits its declared lease.
tasks.negative_control: Source-document fleet size or expired 16-core lease cannot launch work.

tasks.title: Measure representative cost and yield
tasks.instructions: Define BENCH-01..07 with fixed corpus, warm/cold caches, failed attempts, p50/p95 wall/RSS/disk and qualified unique decisions. Record resource class and numerical quality.
tasks.acceptance: Budgets derive from measured work, not peak bandwidth arithmetic.
tasks.negative_control: VRAM occupancy or raw cell updates cannot stand in for useful throughput.

tasks.title: Choose packing and optimize in measured order
tasks.instructions: Benchmark independent jobs before MPI strong scaling; test only permitted rank/thread packs. Add exact caches, reuse, binary I/O and warm starts with invariance tests.
tasks.acceptance: Selected configuration improves complete qualified workflow cost.
tasks.negative_control: A warm-start bias or output-pruning loss invalidates the apparent speedup.

tasks.title: Drill worker/coordinator failures and backup
tasks.instructions: Inject worker loss, stale completion, network delay, quota pressure and coordinator restore while checking actual ledger and logical replay.
tasks.acceptance: No unauthorized process is killed and all attempts remain charged.
tasks.negative_control: A faster cluster run cannot pass by dropping expensive failed candidates.

packets.title: Optional GPU flow and voxel-FEA admission track
edge_cases: No GPU work before a fresh explicit device lease
An in-house solver is a separate research project
Mixed precision and wall models need physics parity, not scalar-only checks
validation_commands: rtk cargo run --locked -p crucible-cli -- verify --suite accelerator --dry-run

tasks.title: Benchmark alternatives before building a new solver
tasks.instructions: Evaluate capability cards for available native acceleration and proposed sparse LBM/voxel FEA. Decide on held-out requirements and measured useful cost; retain reference-only fallback.
tasks.acceptance: An ADR states whether custom kernels are justified.
tasks.negative_control: Assumed 2.5 Gupdates/s or a hypothetical GPU fleet cannot size a campaign.

tasks.title: Build CPU-reference and bounded GPU kernels
tasks.instructions: Stage collision/streaming/boundaries/refinement, deterministic reductions and memory pools; separately stage elasticity/preconditioner/eigensolver. Pin architecture/precision in judge identity.
tasks.acceptance: Every kernel has reference parity, bounds checks and finite-result tests.
tasks.negative_control: FP16 drift, nonconservative block coupling and invalid eigenpairs fail.

tasks.title: Qualify numerical and physical fixtures
tasks.instructions: Use Poiseuille, Taylor-Green/Couette, cavity/channel/swirl and native oil fixtures; structural patch/beam/cylinder/buckling fixtures. Measure order and model applicability.
tasks.acceptance: Verification and actual vortex/structural validation precede ranking.
tasks.negative_control: A fast laminar benchmark cannot qualify turbulent deoiling or nonlinear collapse.

tasks.title: Run held-out paired admission
tasks.instructions: Compare baseline, conventional and novel interior subjects on profiles, grade, pressure, loads, ranking/omission and uncertainty at matching decision quality. Require proposed >=1.3x end-to-end gain only after policy approval.
tasks.acceptance: Admission is per model/level/envelope and automatically revoked on relevant version change.
tasks.negative_control: Agreement on selected winners alone cannot admit the accelerator.

tasks.title: Record pass or reference fallback
tasks.instructions: On failure keep accelerated outputs exploratory and run mature native solvers with a smaller preregistered budget. Refuse a performance promise until measured.
tasks.acceptance: The core release can complete without an admitted accelerator.
tasks.negative_control: Schedule pressure cannot relax accuracy gates or promote a failed fast lane.

packets.title: Optional frozen-liner response operator
edge_cases: The frozen tail still couples bidirectionally to the head
A hull distance is an abstention heuristic, not a proof
Training and holdout need geometry-family separation

tasks.title: Define complete interface state and conservation
tasks.instructions: Represent radial/azimuthal velocity/turbulence/reverse-core state and size/radial oil mass flux at an admitted cut plane. Include boundary feedback and uncertainty.
tasks.acceptance: Mass/momentum/oil interface balances are independently checked.
tasks.negative_control: A pressure-only tail relation cannot replace the full downstream physics.

tasks.title: Preregister training and held-out full-liner cases
tasks.instructions: Select diverse generated states and family-separated holds with a measured lease. Retain full accepted geometries and raw carrier/transport evidence.
tasks.acceptance: Dataset covers the intended mechanism/state domain with explicit gaps.
tasks.negative_control: Reuse of calibration heads as validation cannot close the gate.

tasks.title: Implement coupled head/tail iteration
tasks.instructions: Use bounded iteration and conservative transfer; measure convergence instead of assuming 2-3 exchanges. Track failures separately from physical infeasibility.
tasks.acceptance: Coupled observables match held-out full-liner reference within decision budget.
tasks.negative_control: Reverse-core inflow omission and unclosed interface flux force fallback.

tasks.title: Measure ranking and omission under random audits
tasks.instructions: Compare low-ranked/OOD as well as promoted cases, with fixed acceptance criteria and uncertainty. Bind admission to operator/model/observer identity.
tasks.acceptance: False omission and abstention rates appear in the benchmark.
tasks.negative_control: Scalar pressure agreement cannot qualify downstream oil grade.

tasks.title: Enforce automatic full-liner fallback
tasks.instructions: Out-of-domain or uncertain state dispatches the full-liner reference; account extra cost and retain all source dependencies.
tasks.acceptance: Optional operator absence does not block a correct smaller campaign.
tasks.negative_control: A depleted budget cannot convert operator abstention into an assumed pass.

packets.title: Evidence-bound scenes and complete Blender recipe registry
edge_cases: A streamline is not a particle history
Display smoothing can alter scientific geometry
Missing evidence renders an unavailable card rather than a plausible field
validation_commands: rtk cargo run --locked -p crucible-cli -- render --suite all --dry-run

tasks.title: Define and validate scene bundles
tasks.instructions: Bind subject, artifacts, observable, units, frame, time/window, mapping/masks, scales, evidence class and recipe to exact hashes. Strip private geometry from unapproved exports.
tasks.acceptance: Wrong-subject/time/unit/transform fixtures fail before rendering.
tasks.negative_control: A nonempty digest string cannot establish subject equivalence.

tasks.title: Map every catalogue family to a recipe
tasks.instructions: Maintain all 66 existing IDs plus new v5 gates. Separate recipe implemented, evidence available and render completed counts. Logical cases use exact data cards.
tasks.acceptance: Coverage checker rejects an unmapped catalogue ID.
tasks.negative_control: Unavailable oil data cannot be filled with authored droplet trajectories.

tasks.title: Build the thin Blender adapter
tasks.instructions: Use an available tested pinned Blender build, separate GPL package and fixed cameras/lighting/seeds. Keep scientific meshes unsmoothed; compose labels/legends outside the part.
tasks.acceptance: Review and publication profiles expose the same scientific geometry and metadata.
tasks.negative_control: An unavailable proposed Blender 5.2 LTS build cannot become an assumed dependency.

tasks.title: Verify quantitative visual semantics
tasks.instructions: Use shared comparison ranges, known scalar/color samples, correct tensor/vector basis, declared exaggeration and true-scale companion. Label all unsimulated motion as illustration.
tasks.acceptance: Unit cubes/mirrored frames and saturation/mask tests pass independently of pixels.
tasks.negative_control: Denoising or an artistic transform cannot alter the quantitative scalar-to-color layer.

tasks.title: Deliver cached interrupted-safe plate generation
tasks.instructions: Cache by bundle/recipe/build/config, resume by completed frames and use separate low-priority leased resources. Human review checks layout after semantic tests.
tasks.acceptance: Every rendered plate has manifest and explicit evidence limitations.
tasks.negative_control: A beautiful image never upgrades source qualification.

packets.title: Read-only evidence explorer and live progress
edge_cases: Browser UI never computes authoritative engineering values
Read-only live API must reject mutation
Stale/revoked data must remain visibly stale in cached views
validation_commands: rtk proxy sh -c "cd apps/explorer && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build"

tasks.title: Replace static imported claims with a typed view
tasks.instructions: Consume versioned read-only manifests/observations with generated TS types. Bind URL state to dataset revision and exact subject rather than hard-coded historical receipt paths.
tasks.acceptance: Every value opens its source, unit, uncertainty and tier.
tasks.negative_control: A stale URL cannot silently show a new champion under the old identity.

tasks.title: Add campaign and budget views
tasks.instructions: Show task/attempt funnel, spend/reservations, checkpoint, control arms, blockers and admitted capability status. Keep software completion distinct from scientific release.
tasks.acceptance: Missing and failed states are visible and accessible.
tasks.negative_control: A high completed-task percentage cannot imply physical validation.

tasks.title: Add subject, gate, archive and lineage inspection
tasks.instructions: Show shared-scale geometry, artifact-supported overlays, Pareto/QD points and discrete recorded ancestry. Preserve historical correction labels.
tasks.acceptance: Wrong geometry/field/time combinations cannot be selected.
tasks.negative_control: Interpolated invented ancestors or reconstructed particle paths are rejected.

tasks.title: Expose revocation and offline dossiers
tasks.instructions: Invalidate dependent cached values on registry events; serve the same evidence semantics in offline reviewed bundles. Weight controls read stored alternative decisions or label scratch views.
tasks.acceptance: Revoked claims lose current eligibility in both live and offline metadata.
tasks.negative_control: A browser weight slider cannot rewrite registered decisions or requirements.

tasks.title: Verify accessibility and truthful content
tasks.instructions: Exercise keyboard focus, reduced motion, responsive layout, absent-field placeholders and historical claims. Run build and targeted browser checks.
tasks.acceptance: No retracted pressure gain or coupled-trajectory label survives without source support.
tasks.negative_control: Missing evidence never renders as zero, empty green cell or a plausible fake field.

packets.title: Preregistered research, mechanism study and query-built paper
edge_cases: Discovery, archive novelty, mechanism novelty and external novelty are different claims
A changed endpoint after results requires a new labeled study
Knockout changes can introduce confounding geometry
validation_commands: rtk cargo run --locked -p crucible-cli -- paper build --fixture

tasks.title: Freeze study arms and estimands prospectively
tasks.instructions: Use staged representation x optimizer controls, competent conventional optimization and targeted ablations. Set independent seeds, pilot-based power, resource-vector normalization and confirmation budget before generation zero.
tasks.acceptance: Analysis/stop/exclusion/holdout policy is hashed in the experiment family.
tasks.negative_control: An unavailable L4 budget cannot trigger a post-hoc endpoint swap after winners are known.

tasks.title: Run qualified confirmation without winner leakage
tasks.instructions: Report cost-quality curves, uncertainty and negative outcomes. Use fresh confirmation data/independent units and retain all attempted finalists under the family policy.
tasks.acceptance: Each claimed winner has matching admission and confirmation scope.
tasks.negative_control: Many parcels, frames or optimizer generations cannot inflate independent n.

tasks.title: Design mechanistic interventions
tasks.instructions: Use compiled-geometry knockout, sham, rescue and volume/area-matched controls where feasible; rerun accepted subjects and report flow changes and limitations.
tasks.acceptance: Ablation isolates a specified physical hypothesis rather than a feature label.
tasks.negative_control: Improvement after deleting a module alone cannot prove causal mechanism.

tasks.title: Replace fuzzy numeric matching with typed queries
tasks.instructions: Bind claims to exact observation/subject/scenario/estimand/unit/tier and allowed interpretation; generated figures reference manifests. Keep historical paper and corrections immutable.
tasks.acceptance: Wrong denominator/unit/subject/stale tier planted errors fail the paper build.
tasks.negative_control: A receipt number times 1000 or within 0.15% is not acceptable proof of a prose claim.

tasks.title: Build reproducible private/public review bundles
tasks.instructions: Retain full governing evidence privately; create allowlisted offline reproduction and dependency/license/prior-design inventory. Publication/disclosure decisions remain external owner decisions.
tasks.acceptance: A negative result can produce a complete paper and seed package.
